title: Last NFT from the supply can't be minted
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as only one NFT won't be available for minting, but this is value loss to the protocol  **Likelihood:** High, as it's impossible to mint the last NFT  ## Description  Currently both the `mint` and `mintPhysical` methods have the following check:  ```solidity if (nextId + amount >= MAX_SUPPLY) revert ExceedsMaxSupply(); ```  This is incorrect, as even when the `nextId` is `MAX_SUPPLY - 1` then an `amount` of 1 should be allowed but with the current check the code will revert. This is due to the `equal` sign in the check, which shouldn't be there. Here is a Proof
